Do painted miniatures count as fan art? I don't know, but why not?

Unity's golems were easy to paint, so I started with them.

![Painted Golems](upload://pVY3umrgKENbcXuVpyfEh8o2RBr.jpeg)

Bunker and Absolute Zero also had simple color schemes, though I wasn't sure if Bunker was supposed to be more of a gold, bronze, or dull yellow. I went with a dark bronze. I did their traditional colors, not the new Tactics outfits.

![](upload://qsgr78YB1Hhk7b9lmFpfALwqxNl.jpeg)

I also did Omniton, but I haven't taken a picture of him separately, so here he is with everyone else:

![](upload://r7ESd6UyuDg4QpxGYLnA7gtaXcJ.jpeg)

Anyone have a good way to get a glowing effect for Omnitron's upper carapace?

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked: I got what felt like a pretty good blue glowing effect when I did the Bjarlspire GSF ship. You can see it here, in case it's something you want to try. What I did was paint the area medium blue then mix medium and light blue and speckle the center of the area with that. Then I'd mix more light blue into that mix and speckle it again in a slightly smaller part of the area, repeating it over and over with lighter and lighter blue. so that the area got progressively lighter towards the center.
